prompt: Make a histogram of the temp_c values.

before.program:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read the provided weather data
weather = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/weather.csv')

# Draw a histogram of all temperature values
fig, ax = plt.subplots()
ax.hist(weather['temp_c'].dropna(), bins=5)
ax.set_xlabel('Temperature (°C)')
ax.set_ylabel('Frequency')
ax.set_title('Histogram of Temperature Values')
fig.tight_layout()
